source: ARGUS-10 read-only pinned sources and reported GitHub issues; some reports are not independently reproduced
design_rule: A proactive hypothesis is not a forecast; detect and test early indicators before claiming a repair or averted outage.
scope: Generate 10 original host-specific SKILL.md candidates in owned isolated repo. Never install or write to third-party repositories without authorization.

stages.Code 1: diagnose, detect risk signals, reproduce within isolated sandbox
stages.Code 2: compose tailored preventive skill, propose minimal patch or test
stages.Code 3: verify regression and baseline, record evidence; no persistent monitoring active

cases.name: OpenHands
cases.purpose: Prevent duplicate/misidentified skills when local and bundled sources use the same skill name.
cases.watch: React card identity is derived only from a name; overlapping local/public skill names can produce unstable reconciliation.
earlySigns: Two distinct skill source records resolve to the same display identity
Cards visually repeat one source path after reload or filtering
cases.preflight: Inspect stable React keys and verify both original skill sources stay distinguishable; read-only simulate same-name/different-source records.
cases.prevention: Create a regression fixture with duplicate display names from different sources. Propose a source-scoped stable identity and verify filtering/selection is preserved.
cases.acceptance: Two skill records with the same name and distinct source IDs render exactly two correctly labeled selectable cards after search, reload and install-state changes.
cases.integration: Run frontend React component tests and Playwright against isolated Agent Canvas, not live accounts.

cases.name: Dify
cases.purpose: Proactively verify MCP OAuth negotiation when initialize succeeds before a protected call.
cases.watch: A successful MCP initialize response need not mean subsequent resources/tools calls are authorized.
earlySigns: Initialize HTTP 200 followed by a 401/WWW-Authenticate response during tools/list
Authentication retry runs without preserving action state
cases.preflight: Require protocol fixtures for HTTP 200 initialize followed by unauthorized tools/list; inventory resource metadata and OAuth challenge parsing.
cases.prevention: Add mocked MCP integration scenario, bounded retry behavior and error report that preserves the original unauthorized cause.
cases.acceptance: Authenticated and unauthenticated mock flows both behave correctly, token refresh is bounded, no infinite retry and no credential leakage.
cases.integration: Python pytest with local mocked MCP transport; no real Google account or tokens.

cases.name: Langflow
cases.purpose: Prevent silent corruption of non-UTF-8 file text and prevent guessing unsupported encodings.
cases.watch: Windows-1252/MacRoman/Windows-1254 detector decisions may be discarded; fallback to permissive codecs hides corruption.
earlySigns: Smart quotes and euro symbols become control characters
Encoding detector confidence is low and permissive fallback silently succeeds
cases.preflight: Run isolated upstream _detect_encoding_with_fallbacks with known CP1252 bytes and a mocked detector; capture mismatched Unicode codepoints.
cases.prevention: Use reviewed conditional fallback policy plus explicit confidence/round-trip tests and preserve UTF-8 behavior; avoid naive Latin-1 acceptance.
cases.acceptance: CP1252 quote, euro, em dash decode correctly; UTF-8 and ASCII remain correct; ambiguous bytes are flagged rather than silently reported as correct.
cases.integration: Real read_text_file pytest fixture in isolated Langflow checkout, then whole-project tests; no uploads of private documents.

cases.name: AnythingLLM
cases.purpose: Prevent user/workspace prompt variables from altering original placeholder positions.
cases.watch: Replacing matches sequentially in a growing result can mutate inserted values before replacing original placeholders.
earlySigns: Inserted value contains literal {key} token
Duplicate token keys or unknown tokens appear in prompt after expansion
cases.preflight: Run upstream expandSystemPromptVariables in a dependency-mocked VM on {first} {second} with first='X {second}' and second='Y'.
cases.prevention: Preserve original match positions through single-pass interpolation or collision-safe source-slot mapping, plus tests for duplicates and unknown tokens.
cases.acceptance: Original placeholders get their own values exactly once, literal inserted placeholders are preserved, unknown keys stay untouched, user-provided text is not recursively expanded.
cases.integration: Server Jest targeted tests in a sandboxed checkout with generated inputs; never use a real user prompt.

cases.name: RAGFlow
cases.purpose: Detect ingestion template drift before legacy Extractor parameters disappear.
cases.watch: Templates may carry older field_name/prompts/sys_prompt format while CleanComponentParams only accepts scoped/normalized parameter schemas.
earlySigns: Template Extractor contains legacy flat keys without an approved migration
Cleaning silently removes required prompts from ingestion
cases.preflight: Compare chunk_summary.json and title_chunker.json Extractor parameters against the Go cleaner/normalizer logic.
cases.prevention: Create schema migration/contract fixtures that fail whenever a template loses prompts after cleaning; test both old and modular templates.
cases.acceptance: Summary/title templates retain configured prompt semantics through parser and Go backend; unknown param rejection remains safe.
cases.integration: Go unit tests and Python ingest-template fixture in an isolated repository checkout.

cases.name: n8n
cases.purpose: Preserve JSON scalar types in HTTP autodetect mode before they corrupt downstream workflows.
cases.watch: A body already parsed as a JSON string may be parsed again, failing plain strings or coercing numeric-looking strings.
earlySigns: JSON top-level "ordinary string" rejected as invalid
JSON top-level "42" converted to number 42
cases.preflight: Check the branch that calls jsonParse on the raw body and later JSON.parse on string output, with fullResponse variations.
cases.prevention: Build typed-fixture regression for JSON primitives, arrays, objects and null through autodetect and explicit-json paths.
cases.acceptance: String, numeric-string, number, boolean, null, array and object all preserve valid JSON value type with both full-response modes.
cases.integration: Targeted n8n HTTP Request node TypeScript tests with a local fake HTTP server; no external URLs.

cases.name: Khoj
cases.purpose: Prevent operator from losing the most recent user turns in long conversations.
cases.watch: History constructor iterates oldest-first and stops when message cap is reached, contrary to its 'last n' contract.
earlySigns: Operator repeatedly answers a superseded user question
Follow-up context disappears after a few turns
cases.preflight: Extract original construct_chat_history_for_operator helper into a controlled Python test, feed three completed turns and assert the most recent turn is retained.
cases.prevention: Build an ordered complete-turn sliding window with attachment integrity and explicit behavior for incomplete trailing turns.
cases.acceptance: Latest n completed turns survive in chronological order, attachments remain on the correct turn, and orphan assistant messages are not inserted.
cases.integration: Focused Python pytest using upstream conversation types; then `/operator` integration smoke.

cases.name: Open WebUI
cases.purpose: Prevent reintroduction of skills editor failures on plain HTTP and non-secure contexts.
cases.watch: Native crypto.randomUUID may be unavailable outside a secure context; upstream issue #32238 was marked closed after dev commits.
earlySigns: Skill editor fails on private LAN HTTP deployment
Console TypeError crypto.randomUUID is not a function
cases.preflight: Inspect Skills UI and new-skill imports for unguarded native randomUUID; compare pinned historic revision to current maintainer patch.
cases.prevention: Retain browser compatibility regression on supported HTTP local scenarios, with graceful UUID fallback and no permission expansion.
cases.acceptance: Create/edit/clone/export skills works in HTTPS and supported HTTP LAN setup without native randomUUID; no regression in security checks.
cases.integration: Svelte frontend unit test + Playwright in isolated browser origins; treat upstream closure as reported, not our repair.

cases.name: Activepieces
cases.purpose: Spot package/metadata load failures of Google Sheets piece before end users open an automation.
cases.watch: Self-hosted piece extraction may fail from missing network/dependency/worker metadata and surface a generic UI error.
earlySigns: Worker EXECUTE_EXTRACT_PIECE_INFORMATION fails
Google Sheets available in catalog but piece action metadata cannot load
cases.preflight: Check supported piece registration and server metadata worker path; do an offline staging smoke in a self-hosted test container.
cases.prevention: Preflight package availability, worker request/response and accessible error cause before enabling a piece for customers.
cases.acceptance: Google Sheets actions load from a clean self-hosted fixture; failures are surfaced clearly and never expose credentials.
cases.integration: Local self-host container and isolated worker integration tests; no live Google authorization.

cases.name: Continue
cases.purpose: Proactively check local Ollama tool-call compatibility before search_web fails in agent mode.
cases.watch: Advertised search_web action may not align with Ollama tool schema or tool results in a local model session.
earlySigns: Agent requests search_web but tool dispatch returns error
Permission settings and model tool-call mode diverge
cases.preflight: Validate search_web registration and Ollama function tool schema; record actual model/provider revision.
cases.prevention: Local fake Ollama server test for tool request/result plus permission-denied and unsupported-tool behavior.
cases.acceptance: Agent can call search_web with a mocked permitted response, fails safely if unavailable and does not issue external requests without authorization.
cases.integration: Continue agent integration test against a local deterministic Ollama protocol fixture, not a live model.
